name: Akisumi
source:
Birth year: 1968

Main character of "1985-1994 scenario"
[url=/c92780]Souji[/url]'s close friend. [url=/c92782]Sakurako[/url]'s boyfriend. [spoiler][url=/c92847]Sumire[/url]'s father.[/spoiler] 
A good-looking boy who is also decent in studying. Akisumi is currently working as a caretaker in an orphanage where he used to spend his life as an orphan before.
Loves raising all kinds of vegetables, to the point of thinking about marriage with one.
Later on, [spoiler]his death was revealed on 22 Mar 1995, due to an accident in the laboratory that he is working for.[/spoiler]
